Question
========
You've written some R code and you press "Run" inside RStudio. Which program actually executes
the code and computes the result?

Answerlist
----------
* R.
* RStudio.
* Both, equally, with no real difference.
* Neither; the code runs on Posit's servers.

Solution
========
R is the engine that actually executes code and computes results. RStudio is the interface (the
"dashboard") that you type in and that sends your code to R.

Answerlist
----------
* Correct
* Wrong: RStudio is the interface around R; it sends your code to R to be executed.
* Wrong: RStudio itself does not compute anything, it needs R to do that.
* Wrong: RStudio Desktop runs locally on your own machine using your local installation of R.
